meta_tools.name: codespar_pay
meta_tools.description: Propose Pix payouts. This does NOT pay: it creates executions in `drafted` that the core checks against the mandate and, depending on the approval mode, asks a person or runs. Two shapes. With `batch_ref` it runs a whole batch from list_payables (suppliers, commissions or payroll) as one execution PER LINE, so a refusal on one payee does not stop the others and re-running the same batch pays nobody twice; the lines come from the payables file, so never send items or total_minor with it. With `items` it proposes a single one-off payout to named payees. Amounts are in BRL cents.

batch_ref.description: A batch_ref from list_payables (e.g. folha-2026-10). Runs every open line of that batch. Cannot be combined with items.

items.description: A one-off payout, outside any batch. Cannot be combined with batch_ref.

payee.description: A payee alias from list_payables. Never a raw Pix key somebody typed in the chat.

total_minor.description: Optional, and only with items. What you believe the total is. The core recomputes it and yours is only recorded.

meta_tools.name: codespar_ledger
meta_tools.description: Read the receipt of a settled payout by receipt id, or list the executions of this mandate with their states.

local_tools.name: list_payables
local_tools.description: The month's payables, grouped into the batches the company runs: suppliers, commissions, payroll. Each line carries its payee alias, name, amount in BRL cents, reference, and whether a previous run of that batch already covers it (`open`, `already_settled`, `in_progress`). Read-only.
